IDENTITY LOCK

Character Summary + Proportion

03 / 14

Head / torso / leg landmarks
Head

Large anime head, short bob
volume, eyes held warm
brown.

Torso

Compact body under an
oversized hoodie silhouette.

Hands

Small hands sit inside long, soft
hoodie sleeves.

Skirt

Gray pleated skirt starts high
and stays visible below the
hem.

Legs

Sturdy youthful legs with fuller
thighs, soft calves, crew socks,
and chunky white sneakers.
